# Skills

Starters: $crav1-spark-to-spec, $crav1-ideas-to-spec, $crav1-bundle-to-specs, $crav1-existing-to-specs, $crav1-read-environment, $crav1-fix-bug

## Specify

### Start
- $crav1-spark-to-spec | starter | You have 1–2 sentences
- $crav1-ideas-to-spec | starter | A pile of ideas and hunches
- $crav1-bundle-to-specs | starter | Mixed files, or several v0 features

### Specify
- $crav1-review-architecture | Spec, diagrams, or ADRs exist
- $crav1-tighten-spec | The spec is still mushy
- $crav1-resolve-open-questions | Open questions remain

## Plan

### Plan
- $crav1-plan-from-spec | Spec is accepted
- $crav1-review-plan | Plan exists; want a critique
- $crav1-tighten-plan | Plan findings, or mushy tasks

## Build

### Build
- $crav1-build-tasks | You want to build one task, a range, or all unticked tasks
- $crav1-build-features | Several specs, one after another
- $crav1-build-walk | A ready slice should be built one work branch at a time, through the pull request and the merge

### Verify and fix
- $crav1-verify-build-against-spec | Want proof against acceptance
- $crav1-fix-build-gaps | verify.md lists gaps, or a live host path fails

## Cross-cutting

### Start
- $crav1-existing-to-specs | starter | The user names existing repos, with or without a bundle to match
- $crav1-read-environment | starter | The user names the host
- $crav1-fix-bug | starter | The user names a real bug
- $crav1-help | You want to know what to run next, in what order, or what a skill does
- $crav1-update-kit | The installed kit should move to a published release, or an early-access flag should be listed or changed
- $crav1-tasks-ready-to-build | You want to know which tasks can be built now, and why the others cannot, or you want the build map

### Meetings and open questions
- $crav1-show-or-ask-open-questions | You want to see what is still open, or draft questions to ask
- $crav1-record-approval | You have a person's yes to record on an Approval needed item

### Keep the picture current
- $crav1-add-to-spec | New information for specs that already exist
- $crav1-explain-existing-system | System notes already exist
- $crav1-explain-this-code | You want one piece of code explained
- $crav1-explain-tech | You want one technology explained in the context of your specs
- $crav1-retire-spec | A spec is done, dead, belongs in another spec, should wait, or is only reference knowledge
- $crav1-what-do-we-know-about-this | One feature, slice, or resource
- $crav1-model-data | You want a data model from the specs
- $crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs | Many repos or pull requests should be caught up into the specs
- $crav1-refresh-system-notes | Something was added; catch the picture up
- $crav1-map-pipeline-environments | The user names Azure DevOps, the org, and the project
- $crav1-review-security | Architecture already exists
- $crav1-glossary | You want the glossary, the meaning of one word, or the open glossary rows filled
- $crav1-export-spec | Spec exists; want another format

### Specify
- $crav1-design-architecture | You want to decide how the architecture should change

### Azure Boards
- $crav1-ado-sync | Specs and Azure Boards should match

### Testing helpers
- $crav1-run-exploratory-test | A build of a slice already exists
- $crav1-suggest-tests-for-code | The user points at existing code

### Commit and pull request
- $crav1-create-feature-branch | Brownfield: leave the default branch
- $crav1-finalize-commit | You want the commit message, or the commit itself
- $crav1-open-pr | Commits exist; want a pull request
- $crav1-host-setup | You need a branch policy, required build, reviewers, an approval or a variable group set on the host
- $crav1-review-pr | This turn names an open pull request
- $crav1-pr-status | You want to know what is done and what is left on a pull request, and what you owe
- $crav1-merge-pr | This turn asks to merge a named pull request

### Guided walks
- $crav1-tighten-and-plan-ready-to-build | A spec should be tightened and planned until it is ready to build

## Subagents
- crav1-spec-reviewer-agent | specify | Independent product and spec critique. | reads: `spec.md` and what the spec links to. | writes: Nothing | leaves alone: The spec and code.
- crav1-review-architecture-agent | specify | Hunches versus decisions, diagrams, and ADRs. | reads: `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, `adr/`, and `export/` when those exist. | writes: Nothing | leaves alone: The spec and code.
- crav1-plan-reviewer-agent | plan | Plan and tasks against the spec. | reads: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`. | writes: Nothing | leaves alone: The plan and code.
- crav1-build-task-agent | build | One `T#` from implement to commit, in isolation. | reads: One `T#` (`spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`). | writes: That task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits | leaves alone: `spec.md`, other `T#`s, push, and the pull request.
- crav1-bundle-slice-agent | specify | One v0 feature slug after the intake map. | reads: `docs/system/` and what the parent passes for that slug. | writes: `docs/specs/<slug>/` only | leaves alone: `docs/system/`, `work-item.md`, code, and every other slug.
